name: Shree Cement Ltd
title: Shree Cement Ltd - 500387 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Shree Cement's Q4 FY26 volume rose 11% YoY, but utilisation at 66% and planned capex cut to ~INR1,500 crore for FY27 point to a supply-side slowdown while management pivots to chasing volume.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter stood at 66% as compared to 56% during December 2025.

capex.peers_comment: Management said a competitor's last call also showed it had slowed its aggression.
capex.quote: We have slowed down the capex. Even in the last concall of one of our competitors, they have also slowed their aggression.

triggers.label: Utilisation 56% → 66% QoQ
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter stood at 66% as compared to 56% during December 2025.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR1,500 crore
triggers.quote: the total capex estimation for the year '26-'27 is approximately INR1,500 crores and it should take its own course.

triggers.label: Price hike ~INR25 a bag in past month
Cost push INR150-200/t in Q1
triggers.quote: there will be a cost impact of INR150 to INR200 in the second quarter as compared to the March '26.

triggers.label: Slowdown after 15 April
triggers.quote: Till 15th April everything was all right. After that little slowdown has come.

triggers.quote: As Mr. Bangur has said it is possible that competition pressure might rise
